recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid white (#FFFFFF).
2. Place the title text box across the top center (full slide width, approx 0.3 in from the top edge): text 'Precision and Recall of Multi-class classification', bold sans-serif, 32 pt, font color red #C00000, center-aligned.
3. Place a circle (approx 0.6 in diameter) in the top-right corner (approx 0.3 in from the top and right edges), fill light yellow #FFF2CC, with black sans-serif text '18' (approx 14 pt) centered inside.
4. In the top-left quadrant (approx x=0.4 in, y=1.1 in, width=6.2 in, height=3.6 in), draw a rectangle with white fill and a light green #E2EFDA border (approx 2.5 pt) to frame the confusion matrix.
5. Inside the top of that frame, center the header text 'Predicted as' (black, bold, sans-serif, approx 14 pt) with '(Positive Class)' directly beneath it (black, approx 11 pt).
6. Below the header, insert a 4-row x 5-column table with white fill and thin black gridlines. Row 1, columns 2-5 are the column headers: 'Dog', 'Cat', 'Fish', 'Total'. Rows 2-4, column 1 are the row labels: 'Dog', 'Cat', 'Fish'. All header and label text black sans-serif, approx 12 pt.
7. Add a vertical text box rotated 270 degrees at the far left of the table, spanning rows 2-4, with black text 'Actual' (approx 12 pt).
8. Enter the cell values (black, approx 12 pt, center-aligned): Row 'Dog': 5, 2, 1, Total 8. Row 'Cat': 4, 6, 1, Total 11. Row 'Fish': 7, 0, 0, Total 7.
9. Apply light yellow fill #FFF2CC to exactly the nine interior cells (rows Dog/Cat/Fish x columns Dog/Cat/Fish); leave the header row, the row-label column, and the Total column white (#FFFFFF).
10. To the right of the table (middle-right area, vertically centered on the table), add the text 'Confusion Matrix' in blue #0000FF, sans-serif, approx 16 pt.
11. Build the bottom-left column (left third of slide width, lower half) as a three-box vertical stack: (a) top rounded rectangle filled pale pink-lavender #EDE7F6 with black bold text 'Precision and Recall of DOG Class'; (b) middle rectangle filled #FFF2CC with dark red #C00000 text 'Precision=5/(5+4+7)=5/16'; (c) bottom rectangle filled #FCE4D6 with dark red #C00000 text 'Recall=5/(5+2+1)=5/8'.
12. Build the bottom-center column with the identical three-box stack: header 'Precision and Recall of CAT Class' on #EDE7F6; 'Precision=6/(6+2+0)=6/8' on #FFF2CC; 'Recall=6/(6+4+1)=6/11' on #FCE4D6.
13. Build the bottom-right column with the identical three-box stack: header 'Precision and Recall of FISH Class' on #EDE7F6; 'Precision=0/(0+1+1)=0' on #FFF2CC; 'Recall=0/(0+0+7)=0' on #FCE4D6.
14. Apply sans-serif font throughout; all table and body text black #000000; formula text dark red #C00000; leave all elements static with no animations.
